extDescription.message: Multi-provider AI text processing directly in your browser

activity_empty.message: All caught up! No recent activity to show.

help_step1_desc.message: Set up your preferred AI provider (Ollama, OpenAI, Gemini, and more) in Settings.

help_step2_desc.message: Choose your preferred LLM in Settings.

help_step3_desc.message: Select text and press the shortcut.

help_faq1_desc.message: Highlight any text on a webpage to open the quick menu and choose an action. You can also type a custom one-time prompt directly from the quick menu.

help_faq2_desc.message: By default, press Opt+Shift+Q (Mac) or Alt+Shift+Q (Win) to open the selection menu. You can customize these in Chrome settings.

help_faq3_title.message: Can I change the predefined shortcuts? How?

help_faq3_text.message: Yes! If shortcuts conflict with other plugins or you prefer different ones, you can change them in Chrome settings:

help_faq4_desc.message: Use the Opt+Shift+R shortcut (default) to immediately run your default context on selected text without opening the menu.

help_faq5_desc.message: Go to Settings tab to add, edit, or delete your own custom contexts and prompts.

help_faq6_desc.message: Make sure your AI provider is configured and enabled in Settings, and that you have selected a model. For Ollama, ensure the server is running locally.
